source: Direct owner rewrite in the current conversation; the situation was hypothetical.
scope_note: This round adds one short chat reply to an invitation the owner is unlikely to accept.

cases.scenario: 熟悉同学约周末看电影；本人更想休息，不太想去。
cases.preferred_text:
看什么电影？
我应该不去
累了
cases.case_observation: 先问具体看什么，再说‘我应该不去’，最后单独补‘累了’；保留换行与未完全定死的说法。
cases.generalization_limit: 只校准这个假设邀约；不推导为所有拒绝都先追问、使用‘应该’或拆成三行。

interpretation_constraints: This was a hypothetical invitation, not an actual plan or statement of current fatigue.
Preserve the owner's wording and line breaks without inferring message bubbles.
Do not turn the reply into a firmer refusal than the owner wrote.
